window.dividends: not reconstructed; not added as cash

fill.timing: next session open after the signal bar

costs.note: LEAN default per-share fee is not this spec. A LEAN run that uses it must be labeled.

accounting.cash: starting cash minus fills and fees
accounting.equity: cash plus mark-to-market of open position
accounting.fractionalShares: allowed in Backtrader; LEAN integer unless configured

promotion: none. This spec does not approve a strategy.
